target_family_source.rule: a target is in the funding family when its return mechanically shares a component of the usd_funding composite (broad_dollar, real_yield_10y, high_yield_oas): rates and credit through yields and spreads; USD-quoted commodities and non-US equity funds through the dollar numeraire. Each such target is evaluated against a leave-target-family-out baseline (protocol section 6)

families.note: the broad dollar and its FX legs; fx legs are UNPROVEN in the card and never enter a v1 baseline
HY OAS is UNPROVEN and does not feed the first outcome; listed so the family is complete
no registered target mechanically shares a balance-sheet component; no target maps here

member_rule: an outcome whose target_id is itself a family member (e.g. dtwexbgs as an outcome) belongs to that family
rule: drop the family containing the target from direct-input comparators; report as sensitivity, never as the v1 result
first_outcome_note: spy maps to [] (T13 leave_target_family_out false), so the mask is empty for the v1 first outcome; the card's B5 lagged common-risk-factor baseline replaces leave-target-family-out for spy
